  -- turn the statement about `abs` into one about `‖·‖`
  have hnorm : ∀ z ∈ Ω, ‖f z‖ = c := by

    simpa [Complex.abs_eq_norm] using hc z hz
  -- a holomorphic function with constant norm is constant
  have hconst : IsConst f Ω :=
